bugs.title: Freeze and Cancel membership actions permanently disabled on every row
steps: Open Memberships directory.
Click the row-actions menu on any Active membership row (tested QA_AP rows and existing rows).
bugs.expected: Freeze enabled for Active memberships; Cancel enabled with a confirmation dialog.
bugs.actual: Both “Freeze” and “Cancel membership” are greyed out/disabled on every row. The Frozen tab count is 0, suggesting freeze has never worked on dev. Because of this, freeze/unfreeze toast counts, cancel confirmation, and admin freeze/resume audit-trail attribution could not be tested. RE-CONFIRMED 2026-10-17 (Phase 2 sweep): Freeze/Cancel still disabled on Active, Pending, Cancelled, Expired rows and on the newly created QA_AP membership.
bugs.fix: Enable Freeze for Active memberships and Cancel with confirmation; check the permission/plan-state gating that disables them.

bugs.title: Recording a payment with Received date = today fails in the evening (server UTC-date validation)
steps: Open any open invoice (e.g. INV-2026-000048).
Click Record payment: Amount $104, Cash, Received on 10/15/2026 (today).
Submit.
bugs.expected: Today's local date is accepted.
bugs.actual: CONFIRMED by a second independent pass (2026-10-15): recording a payment with today's date failed again with the same error; backdating to 10/14/2026 worked. Original observation: toast “Error — receivedAt is required and may never be in the future.” The server appears to compare against the UTC date (already Oct 16). Workaround: backdating to 10/14/2026 succeeded (receipt RCP-AC1-000149). Note the Add Membership offline flow accepted 10/15/2026 the same evening — validation is inconsistent across flows. Blocks same-day payment recording ~5 hrs/day (19:00–24:00 ET). RE-VERIFIED 2026-10-17 (Phase 2 sweep): future date 12/31/2027 rejected with toast "receivedAt is required and may never be in the future"; malformed 13/99/2026 rejected inline with "Enter a valid date." Nothing was committed.
bugs.fix: Validate receivedAt against the facility's local date (America/New_York), not UTC; align validation across all payment flows.

bugs.title: New Lead dialog: phone country selector reverts to Brazil, blocking valid US numbers
steps: Open People > Leads > New lead; fill step-1 names + email.
Open the phone country selector, click “United States +1”.
Interact with the phone field (fill/type).
bugs.expected: The selected country persists.
bugs.actual: CONFIRMED by a second independent pass (2026-10-15): the phone input auto-detects country from leading digits — 555→Brazil, 212→Morocco, 415→Switzerland — so the selector mis-fires even without manual interaction; full international format (14155550132) works around it. Original observation: the selector reverts to Brazil (+55) on nearly every interaction; entering 5550101234 formats as “+55 (50) 10123-4” with “Invalid phone number for Brazil”. It persisted once after clicking Email to blur first, then reverted again on the next fill. Workaround: select US, blur, then type-append a valid NANP number (+1 (312) 456-7890). (The validator rejecting 555 area codes and 0/1 central-office codes is expected NANP behavior.)
bugs.fix: Persist the selected country on the phone input's state; don't reset it on field interaction/blur.

bugs.title: Membership actions: bad cancel ids make all freezes, unfreezes and cancels fail with 503 for 30 s instead of a 404

bugs.actual: 7 rows appear with statuses Paid, Past Due, and Partially Paid. No invoice with a Refunded status is findable, so the tab is misleading about what it contains.
bugs.fix: Filter the Refunded tab to refunded invoices only, or relabel the tab to match its actual contents.

bugs.title: Billing search ignores the payer column despite the placeholder saying it matches payer
steps: Open Billing.
In the search box (placeholder: "Matches invoice #, TXN reference, item, payer, athlete or amount"), type "QA_AP Customer".
bugs.expected: Invoices whose payer is "QA_AP Customer" are returned, as the placeholder promises.
bugs.actual: Result is "No invoices match these filters" even though visible rows show payer "QA_AP Customer". Searching "Alice Test" (athlete) works, so the payer column specifically is not searched.
bugs.fix: Include the payer column in the billing search index, or correct the placeholder text.

bugs.title: Payment detail dialog for a refunded payment shows a "Succeeded" badge and no refund breakdown
steps: Open Payments and search "QA_AP".
Find row RCP-AC1-000150 — it shows status "Refunded", $50.00 refunded of $50.00.
Open the payment detail dialog.
bugs.expected: The detail header reflects the refunded state and shows the refund breakdown (refunded amount, date, reason).
bugs.actual: Header badge says "Succeeded" Cash; Amount $50.00, Applied $0.00, Unapplied $0.00; no refund information is shown anywhere in the dialog.
bugs.fix: Show a Refunded badge and the refund details (amount, date, reason) in the payment detail dialog.
